about.title: About Siem Reap Art Center Night Market
body: The Siem Reap Art Center Night Market is an evening market space in Siem Reap, Cambodia, where locals and visitors gather after dark to browse stalls, enjoy food, and take in the town's nightlife.
Like other night markets across Cambodia and Southeast Asia, it reflects an everyday urban rhythm — a relaxed public space shaped by local commerce rather than formal tourism.
Small stalls offer handmade goods, traditional artworks, and souvenirs, while the surrounding area highlights Cambodian local arts and the casual culture of street-side evening life.

transport.title: How To Get There
transport.intro: The market sits within Siem Reap town, within reach of most central areas. Below are practical ways to reach it.

airport.title: From Siem Reap International Airport
airport.desc: The airport is located outside the town (about 50 km from the center). The trip to the city generally takes 45–60 minutes by road.
steps: After collecting your luggage, go to the official taxi or tuk-tuk counter in the arrivals hall.
Arrange a ride to 'Art Center Night Market' or 'Hospital Street (17000), Siem Reap'.
Confirm the drop-off point near the riverside entrance of the night market.
Keep the market's map location or Plus Code (9V24+W2F) handy to show the driver.

modes.title: Walking
modes.desc: Suitable for visitors staying near the town center.
steps: From Pub Street or the Old Market area, head south toward the Siem Reap River.
Cross the river and continue to Hospital Street (Street 17000).
The market entrance is along the riverside promenade — about 10–15 minutes on foot.

modes.title: Tuk Tuk
modes.desc: A common and flexible way to get around Siem Reap.
steps: Ask your hotel or a street tuk-tuk driver for a ride to 'Art Center Night Market'.
Show the driver the map location or Plus Code 9V24+W2F if needed.
Most trips from the town center take about 5–15 minutes depending on traffic.

modes.title: Bicycle
modes.desc: Good for short-distance movement around town.
steps: Rent a bicycle from your guesthouse or a local shop.
Follow the riverside road south toward Hospital Street.
Park your bike at the edge of the market area; always use a lock.

modes.title: Car / Taxi
steps: Book a taxi or use a ride arranged by your hotel.
Set the destination as 'Art Center Night Market, Hospital Street'.
Ask to be dropped near the main riverside entrance.

items.q: What time does Siem Reap Art Center Night Market open?
items.a: Usually from 16:00 to 23:00, Monday to Saturday. Hours may change.
The market generally does not require a general admission ticket.
Visitors of different ages can experience the evening market atmosphere.
Visitors may find local handicrafts, souvenirs and cultural products.
